change_record.title: CSSLint and ESLint configuration files are no longer scaffolded

description.excerpt: Drupal 12 no longer provides the following linting configuration files in the web root through Composer scaffolding: .csslintrc .eslintignore .eslintrc.json Drupal core replaced CSSLint with Stylelint in Drupal 8.4.0. The scaffolded CSSLint configuration is obsolete. The scaffolded ESLint configuration extended core’s configuration, but projects still needed to install ESLint and its dependencies themselves.
